caption: The drawing depicts three distinct elements on a plain, off-white background. The upper central area features a large, detailed rendering of a green helmet-like object with a textured, crackled surface pattern and multiple subtle shades of green, with hints of white highlights and gray shadows indicating depth and curvature. Below and to the left, there is a small, square grid composed of green vertical and horizontal lines forming a regular pattern of lighter green and white squares. Below and to the right, there is a circular line drawing resembling the same helmet-like form viewed from above, rendered in fine, gray pencil lines with intricate surface detailing but left uncolored. The composition is arranged so that there is more empty space around the objects, with each element distinctly separated from the others on the page.
title: Bonnet
